Exact-path keys cover one file; keys ending in '/' cover a directory subtree (the generated-asset convention). Community assets are Hive Workshop resources fetched 2026-08-07 with the user's authorization — per-author credit is mandatory and repeated in README.md and the in-game -credits command; author terms honored; no bulk mirroring. 'modified' records any local change (script committed under assets/). The Sol* files are externally-authored COMMISSIONED models (AI fleet Sol, delivered 2026-08-07, accepted through the full sanity gate at 0 errors/0 severes/0 warnings, negative-controlled) — credited like community authors: here, in README.md, and in -credits.
